name: Mosaic Variant Calling Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmarking study of mosaic variant calling strategies that compares methods and provides practical guidelines.
reputation: A well-regarded, practical benchmarking study in the genomics community that is cited for guidance on mosaic variant calling best practices.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance depends strongly on allele fraction and sequencing depth; risk of contamination and sample-specific biases; limited by realistic low-frequency variant representation.
